property_summary: For any address whose low-level call in withdraw() fails, the reference contract preserves their balance, while the buggy version always zeroes it, leading to a difference in balances.
change_summary: Remove the require statement checking the result of the external call, which can cause the balance to be zeroed even if the call fails (reverting on the require but leaving state unchanged if sender uses try/catch, or changing state if revert occurs before zeroing — here deletion prevents revert, always zeroing the balance regardless of call success).
